body: A decision about what comes next may force you to confront who actually controls the money, access, information, or authority needed to make it happen. When Pluto conjuncts the North Node, the plan can become inseparable from the power required to carry it out. A negotiation, transfer of authority, difficult boundary, new source of funding, or exit from an unequal setup may matter more than another round of deciding what you want. Wanting change and having leverage are different problems. Find the leverage, then use it on the condition that is limiting your choices.
